verdict.rationale: For trademarks, the USPTO documents the Trademark Status and Document Retrieval (TSDR) system, where new applications appear. It also publishes public average wait times for each examination stage and offers a Decisions and Proceedings search tool. Other tracking is account-gated: Trademark Center docketing tracks only applications filed through it, and Patent Center says only registered users can track an application's progress. missing for 10: explicit evidence that TSDR status lookup works without logging in, any public no-login status lookup for patent applications, and hands-on corroboration of a founder checking a case's status from public pages.
